import datetime as d, docx
D=d.date
for x in [D(2024,11,17),D(2024,11,15),D(2025,1,14),D(2025,1,16),D(2025,2,15),D(2026,2,17),D(2026,4,18),D(2026,3,27),D(2027,3,27),D(2027,5,30),D(2026,9,2),D(2024,12,15),D(2025,1,2),D(2024,12,3),D(2024,12,2),D(2025,3,17),D(2025,1,31),D(2026,1,31)]: print(x, x.strftime("%a"))
print(D(2024,10,18)+d.timedelta(120), D(2024,10,18)+d.timedelta(90), D(2024,10,18)+d.timedelta(30))
print(D(2025,1,16)+d.timedelta(60), D(2024,11,15)+d.timedelta(60), D(2025,2,1)-d.timedelta(60), D(2025,2,1)-d.timedelta(30), D(2025,2,1)-d.timedelta(60))
print(D(2026,12,1)-d.timedelta(90), D(2026,12,1)+d.timedelta(180))
# 15 business days from Dec 16 2024 excluding Dec25, Jan1
x=D(2024,12,15); n=0; hol={D(2024,12,25),D(2025,1,1)}
while n<15:
  x+=d.timedelta(1)
  if x.weekday()<5 and x not in hol: n+=1
print("SWPPP review",x)
print(docx.__version__ if hasattr(docx,"__version__") else "docx ok")
EOF
